items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1959-10-26
items.q: I had men like Eugene West used to come to me for melodies. And I'd give them songs.

ctx.x: Within the last year? Within the last year. And I have 25 others that is not copyrighted. Then I have about 30 or 40 of them that has no copyright that I've had laying in the drawer for me. Many, many years. Many of them. I had men like Eugene West used to come to me for melodies. And I'd give them songs. And when they come out they were different. I'll show you in a pack right here. I give them a song and it was called Once In A While. And then they changed the title. And what you think they did, they took the…
I don't know. Do you have any pieces among the ones that you haven't published, which might be described as jazz pieces in the sense that Tiger Rag and pieces like that?
